users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Students, teachers and parents who can sign in to Campusly.

search.STUDENT: Search by name or Student ID
search.TEACHER: Search by name or Staff ID

confirm.resetBody: {{count}} user(s) get a new temporary password. Their current password and every open session stop working.
confirm.printBody: A login slip shows a password, and stored passwords cannot be read back. So {{count}} user(s) first get a new temporary password; their current password and sessions stop working.
confirm.blockBody: {{count}} user(s) are signed out and cannot sign in until you unblock them.
confirm.moveBody: {{count}} student(s) leave their current class and its courses and join the courses of the new class.

slips.title: New sign-in details
slips.warning: These passwords are shown only now. Print or copy them before you close this window.
slips.name: Name
slips.heading: Campusly sign-in
slips.rule: This password works for {{signIns}} or {{days}}. After that you set your own password.

add.studentSubtitle: Fill in the details, then save to get the sign-in details.
add.teacherSubtitle: A staff account. The teacher signs in on the teacher portal.
add.title: Title
add.findParent: Find a parent by name or phone
add.linkNote: If this phone already exists, the child is linked to that parent — no new login is created.
add.parentOptional: Leave all parent fields empty to add a parent later.
add.parentIncomplete: Fill in every parent field or leave them all empty.
add.idExplain: ID = year {{year}} + role {{role}} + number {{seq}} · unique, given by the system
add.parentIdExplain: Parent ID = the last 9 digits of the phone.
add.tempNote: The temporary password works for {{signIns}} or {{days}}. Then they set their own.
add.existingAccount: Existing account: now linked to this child, keeps their own password.
add.partial: The student was saved, but the second parent was not: {{error}}

import.title: Import students
import.limits: Up to 300 students, 100 KB. Columns: first_name, last_name, class, admission_year, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_relation.
import.optIds: Generate Student IDs and temporary passwords
import.optParents: Create parent logins (ID = last 9 digits of the phone, temporary password)
import.footnote: After the import you get all login slips on one page to print or save as PDF.
import.previewNote: Preview IDs are not reserved: if someone adds a student meanwhile, the numbers move up.
import.doneBody: New parent accounts and links to existing parents are included. {{skipped}} rows with errors were skipped.

issue.CLASS_NOT_FOUND: Class {{value}} does not exist this year

classes.title: Classes & Courses
classes.subtitle: Each course is one subject taught to one class, e.g. Algebra · 9A.
classes.noClasses: No classes this year yet. Add the first one.
classes.pickClass: Choose a class on the left.
classes.splitNote: {{subjects}} is split into groups — each group is its own course with its own students.
classes.noCourses: No courses in this class yet.
classes.noStudents: No students in this class yet.
classes.archiveHint: An archived class is hidden from lists and pickers. Its history stays.

course.title: Add course
course.subtitle: One subject for one class. Students of the class are enrolled automatically.
course.subject: Subject
course.name: Course name
course.nameHint: Generated from subject and class. You can rename it.
course.choose: Choose students (for split groups, e.g. Korean Group 1)
course.hint: New students who join {{name}} later are added automatically.
course.gradingHint: School default. The teacher can change weights in the Gradebook.

classes.assignBody: {{course}}: the teacher who runs the course and its gradebook.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: School details, grading rules and the academic calendar.

school.title: School
school.subtitle: Shown on login slips and the public site.
school.name: School name
school.localeHint: For new users before they pick their own.
school.timezoneHint: Deadlines, “today” and attendance days use this timezone.
school.contactHint: Phone and hours are shown on the sign-in page under “Forgot password?” and on login slips. Leave empty to hide.
school.telegramHint: The school’s official channel. Shown at the bottom of the public website.
school.botHint: “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page sends people to this bot. Leave empty until the bot works.

grading.title: Grading
grading.subtitle: How a period percent becomes a 5-point mark, and the default weights of new courses.
grading.weightsHint: New courses start with these. Teachers can change them per course.
grading.orderBad: Each mark needs a higher minimum than the next one.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: The rule for temporary passwords on login slips and password resets.
accounts.preview: New temporary passwords work for {{signIns}} or {{days}}, whichever comes first.
accounts.note: Passwords already handed out keep the rule they were given with.

years.title: Academic years
years.subtitle: Classes and courses belong to a year. The current year is what everyone sees.
years.noPeriods: No periods yet. Add the quarters of this year.
years.currentBody: Classes, courses and the CSV import switch to {{name}} for everyone. Students and teachers see its courses.

settings.datesBad: The end date must be after the start date
